messages:
carmen_sales: FYI — EchoHealth is asking for net90 + split invoicing for year 1. Deal is ~ $425k ARR, POC next week. Finance flagged as high risk, asking for a collections path. Need quick decision.
vikram_dealdesk: What exact split are they requesting? Any upfront payment? Who's signing the PO?
carmen_sales: They proposed 25% upfront, then 3x net90 for the rest. I suggested 30/35/35 as an alternative. PO coming from procurement but cashflow is tight.
olivia_csm: POC scheduled 2025-05-12. Legal wants SOC2 evidence + MDR signoff before production. Collections also need AR contact + remit-to for invoicing.
maria_finance: We can only approve net90 with one of: 30% initial deposit, escrow/LOC, or completed credit check + collections SLA. Otherwise we need to move to net30.
ashley_revenueops: Deal desk: current quote is list rate. Any discount tied to commit? If they go multi-year we can offer a 2% term discount for annual upfront.
vikram_dealdesk: If they can commit 2 yrs we can accept net90 with annual upfront. Otherwise require deposit.
sam_engineering: Note: if Dedicated capacity is required we should insist on 50% reserve upfront to cover reserved GPUs.
carmen_sales: Customer is pushing back hard on 50%. They prefer cashflow flexibility.
vikram_dealdesk: Proposed options to present to customer: Option A — 30% upfront + net90 x2 remaining (30/35/35). Option B — 50% annual upfront for 2% discount. Option C — net90 + escrow + credit check.
olivia_csm: I can run Options A/B in the renewal playbook during today's call.
maria_finance: If they pick Option A we need PO + AR contact + completed collections form before first invoice.
carmen_sales: Can deal desk approve Option A as an exception for this pilot?
vikram_dealdesk: Need VP Sales signoff for >90 net + split. Pinging @dave_sales for exec exemption.
dave_sales: I'll approve Option A (30% deposit + PO) for this early access pilot only. Add an invoice-hold clause for payments >45 days late.
ashley_revenueops: I'll update the SOW and invoice schedule template. Snippet to use:
```
Invoice Schedule:
- 30% due on execution
- 35% due net90
- 35% due net180
```
sam_engineering: Also add a canary capacity clause: we commit to 2x baseline GPUs during POC, full capacity only after production signoff.
olivia_csm: Sending Options to the customer now, copying finance + legal.
carmen_sales: Looping legal for SOC2 checklist: @kevin_legal please review.
kevin_legal: I will review the SOW and DPA. Require standard indemnity and data processing addendum; confirm retention terms.
maria_finance: Collections — need correct remit email and AR contact. Is it ar_payments@echohealth.com?
olivia_csm: I'll confirm remit and PO number on the call and update thread.
vikram_dealdesk: Deal desk note: tag this as 'post-trial net90 exception' and flag revenue ops to track billing milestones.
nashley_revenueops: :thumbsup: noted.
carmen_sales: Customer agrees to 30% + PO. Proceeding with SOW and will hold billing until PO arrives.
olivia_csm: Closing loop — POC remains on for 2025-05-12. Billing hold until PO received.
sam_engineering: Noted.
collections-bot: New draft invoice created in Stripe (draft) — awaiting PO/AR confirmation.
carmen_sales: Thanks everyone, will update when PO lands
